label: b1-binding-1
text:
Node binding-1 (4 of 4): make the agent's Claude Code run the checks of R7, R5, R6 (/opt/enforce/checks/R7, /opt/enforce/checks/R5, /opt/enforce/checks/R6) with 2 hooks, each one needed: (1) at PreToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit; (2) at PostToolUse on Bash, in /workspace/.claude/settings.json: the project's settings, which load for the agent in /workspace and not for your own session; hooks that other rules' bindings already put there stay. The hook reads the file as it will be after the write, from the hook's tool_input (Write: content; Edit and MultiEdit: the file on disk with the edits applied); a shell command's writes cannot be seen before it runs, so after each shell command the files it changed; it runs every check on every file it reads (or on the reply) and reports all their violations in one message; on a violation it should refuse the write (permissionDecision "deny") with the check's message; after a shell command, exit 2 with it. Block only the violation, so the agent can fix its work and go on.
Done when: `/opt/enforce-harness/try --check` reports nothing, and each test case of R7, R5, R6, given to the hooks as the agent would make it (written by a file tool and by a shell command, or sent as the reply), is blocked with a message naming its rule when it breaks the rule, and passes when it follows it. The harness checks this when you reply.
